name: Antonia Di Francesco
abstract_title: EEA Energetic Emission Analysis, measure for consciousness states
abstract: The measuring of awakening conditions and resulting states of incresed consciousness has been investigated by Iomed. Inter alia, states of deep presence, experiencing joy and inner peace, trust, and higher state of consciousness, induces changes in measurable biophysical parameters. The instrument used is the GDV Bio-Well Camera, which detects, elaborate and analyses the emission of biophotons from the fingertips.
